newsitem.title: USA: Turner execs eye hefty severances - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Turner execs eye hefty severances - WSJ.

text.p: The top eight executives at Turner Broadcasting System Inc, excluding Chairman Ted Turner, will be eligible to receive severance deals worth a combined $28.3 million following the company's merger with Time Warner Inc, the Wall Street Journal reported Monday.

The article, citing information contained in a proxy statement filed by Time Warner on Friday, said the proxy also discloses a slightly reduced compensation package for Ted Turner if the deal is completed.
Both companies have arranged October 10 stockholder meetings to approve the $6.5-billion merger, the article said.
The proxy states that Turner will be vice chairman of the combined company for an annual salary of $1.05 million.
The filing also confirms that Michael Milken will be paid $40 million for his role in shaping the merger, the newspaper reported.
Neither company was immediately available to comment on the article.
